decisions.reason: The source changes only the arrangement of the existing eight badges; it does not change the approved badge count, catalog membership, or icon designs.
The NFT-size statement is a separate verification clause in the multi-topic message; changing the badge rows does not alter NFT media rendering.
The referral-message wording change is a separate clause and is unaffected by the requested badge-grid arrangement.
The FAQ requirement describes badge purpose and other product behavior, not the visual row arrangement of badge icons.
The source specifies the badge section's 4-by-4 row layout and does not modify the separate landing-page mobile stacking requirement.
The badge-grid adjustment does not change the landing-page hero structure, density, imagery, or control clearance.
Changing how badges are arranged visually does not alter their referral milestones, award destination, or on-chain recording.
The badge-row layout has no effect on prize eligibility, ticket weighting, or Chainlink VRF selection.
The requested badge arrangement does not change dashboard commission accounting or visibility.
The source changes badge presentation only and does not change how prize-ticket counts are recorded or shown.
The About page's textual mention of badges and gamification remains valid regardless of the dashboard badge-row arrangement.
Rearranging badge icons does not alter whether earned badges or prize-ticket state transfer to a secondary buyer.
